title: Agent Output Report
description: Standardized output every agent must produce upon completion. Validated by agent-completion-gate hook.

task_id.description: Task ID matching the context manifest

status.description: complete: all acceptance criteria met. partial: some work done, needs continuation. failed: could not accomplish task.

files_modified.description: Relative paths of all files modified by this agent

files_created.description: Relative paths of all files created by this agent

tests_passing.description: Whether all tests pass after this agent's changes

acceptance_results.description: Per-criterion results from acceptance_criteria in the manifest

tokens_consumed.description: Estimated token consumption for this task

notes.description: Free-form notes about the work done, blockers encountered, or suggestions
